reviews.author: Iris J…
reviews.body:
Let me first say, Tavi is an absolute sweetheart, and I am so glad I found her! I get my nails done at the same salon where she has her business, and even before I became her client, she was always so kind and welcoming to everyone who walked in. She has such a warm presence, and I was fortunate to experience that firsthand. 

I had never had lashes or brow tint done before (though I had previous ombré brows that were starting to fade), so when I asked about alternatives, she introduced me to brow tint. I’m usually very cautious about trying anything new when it comes to my face but she immediately put me at ease. And let me tell you, my expectations were not only met, they were exceeded. I loved my brows so much that I went on to try lash clusters, and now I’m hooked! 😍 I am in love with both my brows and lashes! She gave me just the beautiful natural look I wanted. 

Tavi is not only talented, she is personable, patient, professional, and truly gifted at what she does. It’s rare to find someone who makes you feel comfortable and delivers top-tier results every time. If you’re considering booking with Brows by Tavi, this is your sign! RUN, don’t walk! I 1000% recommend her. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
